title: Why the Double-Root Slice Is Affine Three-Space
statement: In the binary-form multiplication model of the counterexample, the resultant-one double-root slice is polynomially isomorphic to affine three-space.

members.title: The double-root resultant slice is affine three-space
members.statement: In the binary-form multiplication model of the counterexample, the resultant-one double-root slice is polynomially isomorphic to affine three-space.

members.title: Three symmetry orbits of dual binary-cubic hyperplanes
members.statement: Under the projective linear action, dual binary-cubic hyperplanes have three orbits, indexed by the root partitions (3), (2,1), and (1,1,1).

members.title: Comparison with Vitushkin's 1999 rational example
members.statement: Vitushkin's 1999 rational example has an analogous multiplication-map presentation and is generically two-to-one, but its source is a punctured plane, so the resulting map has a pole.
